newsitem.title: INDIA: India Nestle shr falls 5 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: India Nestle shr falls 5 pct on results.

text.p: The share of Nestle India fell 14 rupees or 5.11 percent to 260 on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) after the foods firm unveiled flat first half earnings, brokers said.
The company said on Monday that its net profit was little changed at 223 million rupees in the first six months of calendar 1996 against 222 million in year-ago period.

The profit was squeezed by rising interest costs of 261 million rupees in the first half against 119 million in the same period of 1995, and higher depreciation of 118 million rupees versus 73 million due to the capitalisation of several projects.
The firm is 51 percent owned by Switzerland's Nestle SA.
On the National Stock Exchange, the share was down 14 rupees at 261.
